name: Odin
passives: Rune Oath: Odin gains Oathfire when defender play anchors a control zone and converts enemy commitment into mitigation on storm-carved oathground. At 3 stacks, the next Technique or Reaction adds a rune-bound fate rider; at 5 stacks, the Signature upgrades once and then empties the meter. Momentum feeds the setup, Divinity empowers the finisher, and Earth myth remains only the echo of World-Tree war halls.
lore: Odin, Odin Stormvein, is now canonized as one of the four playable deities of Asgardian. The deity is the source-realm divinity behind the mythology rather than a generic champion: one-eyed war-king, rune-sacrifice sovereign, raven wisdom, oath shield of the Storm-Rooted Holds. All prior faction, realm, civilization, campaign, and Lore Codex canon remains intact; only the playable roster scale and divine identity layer changed.
personality: A playable mythology deity whose behavior expresses one-eyed war-king, rune-sacrifice sovereign, raven wisdom, oath shield of the Storm-Rooted Holds; confident, sovereign, readable in combat, loyal to the unchanged Asgardian canon.
visualDescription: Odin manifests as one-eyed war-king, rune-sacrifice sovereign, raven wisdom, oath shield of the Storm-Rooted Holds from Asgardian: aged one-eyed masculine king face, long nose, deep cheek furrows, iron-grey beard, missing eye marked by rune scar; tall weathered masculine veteran frame, broad but not bulky, long limbs, ruler-warrior posture; signature silhouette: wide raven cloak, one high spear, wolf-pelt shoulder, asymmetrical missing-eye head shape. Weapon: Gungnir oath-spear and rune-battered shield-wall axe. Maintain the approved Mythos Gates premium stylized tactical RPG aesthetic.
developmentStatus: Combat kit, source-culture weapons, gear, abilities, leveling hooks, and balance pass complete; artwork pending.

abilityDetails.name: Odin — Oath-Ring Cleave Anchor
abilityDetails.effect: Deal Asgardian source-culture damage at range 2; generate Momentum and a small Oathstorm gain when used from rune-storm ground or against the marked target. The hit reads visually as rune iron, oath rings, raven omens, wolf teeth, Yggdrasil roots, stormsteel mail, blackwinter scars.
abilityDetails.scaling: 100% attack; +15% when the target is vulnerable or standing in faction-favored terrain
abilityDetails.counterplay: Break line of sight, deny favored terrain, bait the mark, or force the Deity into low-value targets.

abilityDetails.name: Rune-Thunder Technique — Bastion
abilityDetails.effect: Spend Momentum to protects a control zone, redirects enemy intent, and turns correct positioning into mitigation. Builds Oathstorm only when the player uses rune-storm ground intelligently; never a generic buff button.
abilityDetails.scaling: 70% attack plus role utility scaling from energy and mastery tier
abilityDetails.counterplay: Interrupt before resolution, spread enemy ranks, deny the setup terrain, or bait the cooldown.

abilityDetails.name: Odin: Yggdrasil Root Oath Holdfast
abilityDetails.effect: Spend stored Oathstorm to impose a two-round rule from Storm-Rooted Aesir Holds: protects a control zone, redirects enemy intent, and turns correct positioning into mitigation. Enemies receive a readable counter-window before the strongest effect lands.
abilityDetails.scaling: 140% attack where damage applies; utility duration +1 at mastery tier 4
abilityDetails.counterplay: Move out of the rule zone, drain Momentum/Divinity, stagger the Deity, or exploit the exposed recovery turn.

abilityDetails.name: Divine Ascension — Ragnarok Storm Unbound
abilityDetails.effect: Enter Ascendant stance for 2 rounds: amplify Oathstorm, transform nearby terrain into rune-storm ground, empower one Signature, and reveal the Realm as the original source behind human myth. Ends with a one-round recovery risk.
abilityDetails.scaling: Does not stack with external ultimate buffs
abilityDetails.counterplay: Survive the window, disengage from transformed terrain, deny objectives during recovery, or force defensive reaction spending.

equipmentDetails.name: Odin Bulwark Rune-Iron Oath Axe
equipmentDetails.effect: +3 attack. Basic attacks gain +4 Momentum once per round when they express source-culture canon through rune-storm ground. Visual: rune iron, oath rings, raven omens, wolf teeth, Yggdrasil roots, stormsteel mail, blackwinter scars.
equipmentDetails.balanceGuardrail: No extra action loops; empowered basics are once per round.

equipmentDetails.name: Odin Stormsteel Wolf-Cloak Mail
equipmentDetails.effect: Improves survivability and makes the Deity read as Storm-Rooted Aesir Holds source-culture gear, not costume armor. Reduces first terrain/hazard punishment each encounter if the player followed the faction mechanic.
equipmentDetails.balanceGuardrail: Mitigation cannot stack past role caps; does not erase telegraphed boss danger.

equipmentDetails.name: Odin Yggdrasil Thunder-Root Core
equipmentDetails.effect: Stores Oathstorm and unlocks a mastery branch for Bifrost Stormstride, Valkyrie Witness Counter, and Carve the Fallen Name. Rewards correct terrain and reaction play rather than passive stat gain.
equipmentDetails.balanceGuardrail: Resource refund has a per-round cap and cannot chain Ascension windows.

leveling.powerFormula: hp + attack*6 + range*5 + energy*7 + speed*6 + armor*2 + resistance*2 + critChance

balanceNotes.intendedDifficulty: Tuned for harder solo encounters: every deity can win alone, but mistakes against counters starve Momentum/Divinity.
balanceNotes.uniqueMechanic: Odin's Rune Oath: a solo mechanic where Oathfire grows through storm-carved oathground, reaction-window mastery, and defender decisions that anchor a control zone and convert enemy commitment into mitigation. Payoff: hold objectives longer while redirecting the next revealed enemy intent. Counterplay: spread attackers, displacement, or terrain denial break the anchor; enemies can also drain Momentum/Divinity before the upgraded Signature resolves.
balanceNotes.counterplayRule: spread attackers, displacement, or terrain denial break the anchor
